title: SME 13-Week Cash Forecast Builder
description_en: Turn bank balances, open invoices, payables, payroll dates, and known commitments into a reviewable 13-week cash forecast with weekly gaps, assumptions, and owner actions.
description_de: Wandelt Kontostände, offene Rechnungen, Verbindlichkeiten, Gehaltstermine und bekannte Zusagen in eine prüfbare 13-Wochen-Liquiditätsvorschau mit Wochenlücken, Annahmen und Owner-Maßnahmen um.
focus: weekly cash inflows and outflows, liquidity gaps, timing assumptions, and owner decisions
scenario: Metal fabrication shop with 22 staff. Bank balance 84k EUR, open customer invoices 210k EUR (three overdue), supplier payables 120k EUR due within four weeks, payroll 58k EUR on the 28th, VAT payment 31k EUR due in week 3. A 40k EUR machine deposit is planned for week 6.

title: SME Bank Loan Readiness Pack
description_en: Assemble a bank-ready financing brief from business facts, financial signals, collateral notes, and use of funds, and list the evidence a lender will ask for.
description_de: Stellt aus Geschäftsfakten, Finanzsignalen, Sicherheitenhinweisen und Mittelverwendung ein bankfähiges Finanzierungsbriefing zusammen und listet die Nachweise auf, die ein Kreditgeber verlangen wird.
focus: loan purpose, repayment capacity, collateral, lender questions, and evidence gaps
scenario: Regional bakery chain with four outlets wants a 250k EUR loan for a fifth location. Last year revenue 2.1M EUR, EBITDA 190k EUR, existing leasing 45k EUR per year, owner guarantee available. Lease for the new site is negotiated but unsigned.

title: SME Expense Policy Auditor
description_en: Review expense claims and card spend against a written policy, flag exceptions and patterns, and propose reviewable policy or control updates.
description_de: Prüft Spesenabrechnungen und Kartenumsätze gegen eine schriftliche Richtlinie, markiert Ausnahmen und Muster und schlägt prüfbare Richtlinien- oder Kontrollanpassungen vor.
focus: expense exceptions, policy gaps, spend patterns, and control improvements
scenario: IT services firm, 35 employees. Policy caps meals at 35 EUR per person and requires receipts above 25 EUR. Last quarter shows 14 meal claims above the cap, 9 missing receipts, and one recurring software subscription paid by a personal card.

title: SME Budget Variance Explainer
description_en: Explain budget-versus-actual variances by line item, separate one-off effects from structural drift, and propose reforecast actions with owners.
description_de: Erklärt Plan-Ist-Abweichungen je Position, trennt Einmaleffekte von strukturellen Verschiebungen und schlägt Reforecast-Maßnahmen mit Verantwortlichen vor.
focus: budget variances, root causes, one-off versus structural effects, and reforecast actions
scenario: Marketing agency budgeted 620k EUR revenue for H1 and delivered 548k EUR. Freelancer costs were 18 percent above plan, one client paused in March, and a new retainer started in May. Office costs are flat.

title: SME Unit Economics Checker
description_en: Compute and sanity-check contribution margin, customer acquisition cost, payback, and break-even per product or customer segment, with explicit assumptions and evidence gaps.
description_de: Berechnet und plausibilisiert Deckungsbeitrag, Kundenakquisitionskosten, Payback und Break-even je Produkt oder Kundensegment mit expliziten Annahmen und Evidenzlücken.
focus: contribution margin, acquisition cost, payback period, break-even, and pricing implications
scenario: Online furniture brand sells a desk at 449 EUR with 212 EUR landed cost, 38 EUR average shipping, 7 percent returns, and 62 EUR paid-ads cost per order. Repeat purchase rate is unknown.

title: SME Customer Credit Risk Screener
description_en: Screen a new or existing customer for credit risk using payment history, order size, public signals, and contract terms, and recommend limits, prepayment, or escalation.
description_de: Prüft neue oder bestehende Kunden anhand von Zahlungshistorie, Auftragsgröße, öffentlichen Signalen und Vertragsbedingungen auf Kreditrisiko und empfiehlt Limits, Vorkasse oder Eskalation.
focus: payment behaviour, exposure size, warning signals, credit limits, and prepayment or escalation rules
scenario: Wholesale customer places a 68k EUR order, three times its usual size. Two of the last six invoices were paid 20 days late. Their website announced a new CFO last month. Payment terms are 30 days net.

title: SME Subscription Billing Leak Finder
description_en: Find revenue leakage in recurring billing such as unbilled seats, failed renewals, expired discounts, and mismatches between contract and invoice, then propose fixes and controls.
description_de: Findet Umsatzlecks in wiederkehrender Abrechnung wie nicht abgerechnete Nutzer, gescheiterte Verlängerungen, abgelaufene Rabatte und Abweichungen zwischen Vertrag und Rechnung und schlägt Korrekturen und Kontrollen vor.
focus: billing mismatches, unbilled usage, failed renewals, discount expiry, and control fixes
scenario: SaaS company with 340 accounts. CRM shows 4,120 licensed seats, billing shows 3,860. Twelve annual contracts renewed without the agreed 5 percent uplift, and 27 cards failed last month with no dunning follow-up.

title: SME Cost-Cutting Scenario Planner
description_en: Model cost-reduction scenarios with savings, timing, operational side effects, and reversibility, and recommend a sequenced plan that protects revenue and people.
description_de: Modelliert Kostensenkungsszenarien mit Einsparungen, Timing, operativen Nebenwirkungen und Reversibilität und empfiehlt einen sequenzierten Plan, der Umsatz und Mitarbeitende schützt.
focus: cost levers, savings timing, operational side effects, reversibility, and sequencing
scenario: Event catering company must cut 15 percent of monthly cost (currently 190k EUR) within two months. Biggest blocks: staff 92k, kitchen lease 24k, vehicles 11k, food purchasing 41k. Two large contracts run until December.

title: SME Investor And Stakeholder Update Writer
description_en: Draft a concise monthly investor or shareholder update from KPIs, wins, problems, cash runway, and asks, keeping facts separated from projections.
description_de: Entwirft aus KPIs, Erfolgen, Problemen, Cash-Runway und Anfragen ein knappes monatliches Update für Investoren oder Gesellschafter und hält Fakten und Prognosen getrennt.
focus: KPI narrative, wins and problems, cash runway, specific asks, and fact-versus-projection separation
scenario: Seed-funded hardware startup, 9 people. MRR 41k EUR (up 8 percent), runway 11 months, first pilot with a logistics company signed, firmware delay of six weeks, hiring a firmware engineer. Ask: intro to two distributors.

title: SME Cold Outreach Sequencer
description_en: Build a multi-touch outreach sequence for a defined target segment with hooks, value proof, objection handling, and stop rules, without inventing facts about prospects.
description_de: Erstellt eine mehrstufige Outreach-Sequenz für ein definiertes Zielsegment mit Hooks, Wertnachweisen, Einwandbehandlung und Abbruchregeln, ohne Fakten über Interessenten zu erfinden.
focus: target segment fit, message hooks, proof points, objection handling, and cadence stop rules
scenario: Industrial cleaning company targets facility managers of logistics warehouses over 5,000 square metres within 80 km. Proof points: 24-hour response, two ISO certificates, 96 percent contract renewal rate. Channel: email plus phone.

title: SME Sales Pipeline Hygiene Check
description_en: Audit a sales pipeline export for stale deals, missing next steps, unrealistic close dates, and stage inflation, and produce a cleanup list with owner actions and forecast impact.
description_de: Prüft einen Pipeline-Export auf veraltete Deals, fehlende nächste Schritte, unrealistische Abschlussdaten und Stage-Inflation und erstellt eine Bereinigungsliste mit Owner-Maßnahmen und Forecast-Wirkung.
focus: stale deals, missing next steps, close-date realism, stage inflation, and forecast impact
scenario: B2B software reseller with 84 open deals worth 1.9M EUR. 31 deals have no activity in 45 days, 12 are in 'negotiation' with no proposal sent, and 9 close dates are in the past. Quarter ends in three weeks.

title: SME Discount Approval Gate
description_en: Evaluate a requested discount against margin floor, deal size, strategic value, and precedent, and return an approve, counter, or decline recommendation with conditions.
description_de: Bewertet einen beantragten Rabatt gegen Margenuntergrenze, Dealgröße, strategischen Wert und Präzedenzfälle und liefert eine Empfehlung für Freigabe, Gegenangebot oder Ablehnung mit Bedingungen.
focus: margin floor, deal value, precedent risk, trade-offs, and approval conditions
scenario: Sales rep asks for 22 percent off a 140k EUR machinery quote. Standard max is 12 percent, gross margin at list is 34 percent. The buyer is a first customer in a new region and promises a second machine next year without a written commitment.

title: SME Lost Deal Post-Mortem
description_en: Analyse lost or stalled deals for the real reasons behind the loss, separate what was controllable, and produce sales-process and offer improvements with owners.
description_de: Analysiert verlorene oder festgefahrene Deals auf die tatsächlichen Verlustgründe, trennt Beeinflussbares von Unbeeinflussbarem und erstellt Verbesserungen für Vertriebsprozess und Angebot mit Verantwortlichen.
focus: loss reasons, controllable factors, process gaps, offer weaknesses, and improvement actions
scenario: Engineering consultancy lost three of five bids this quarter to a larger competitor. Buyer feedback mentions 'price' twice and 'team availability' once. Proposals were delivered on the deadline day each time and had no reference project from the buyer's industry.

title: SME Key Account Growth Plan
description_en: Turn account history, stakeholder notes, and open needs into a 90-day key account plan with expansion hypotheses, relationship actions, risks, and review metrics.
description_de: Wandelt Account-Historie, Stakeholder-Notizen und offene Bedarfe in einen 90-Tage-Key-Account-Plan mit Expansionshypothesen, Beziehungsmaßnahmen, Risiken und Review-Metriken um.
focus: account health, stakeholder map, expansion hypotheses, relationship risks, and 90-day actions
scenario: Packaging supplier's largest customer (18 percent of revenue) just changed purchasing lead. Volume is flat, two quality complaints last quarter, and the customer is opening a second plant in Poland next spring.

title: SME Referral Program Designer
description_en: Design a referral or partner program with incentives, eligibility rules, tracking, fraud safeguards, and launch steps that fit the company's margin and customer base.
description_de: Entwirft ein Empfehlungs- oder Partnerprogramm mit Anreizen, Teilnahmeregeln, Tracking, Missbrauchsschutz und Launch-Schritten, das zu Marge und Kundenbasis des Unternehmens passt.
focus: incentive design, eligibility rules, tracking, fraud safeguards, and launch sequence
scenario: Physiotherapy practice with 1,400 active patients and a 45 percent average margin per session. Many new patients already come by word of mouth. Legal constraint: no cash payments for medical referrals.

title: SME Trade Show ROI Planner
description_en: Plan a trade show participation with goals, lead targets, budget, staffing, pre- and post-show actions, and a break-even calculation with explicit assumptions.
description_de: Plant eine Messeteilnahme mit Zielen, Lead-Vorgaben, Budget, Personal, Vor- und Nachbereitungsmaßnahmen sowie einer Break-even-Rechnung mit expliziten Annahmen.
focus: show goals, lead targets, budget and staffing, follow-up plan, and break-even assumptions
scenario: Sensor manufacturer considers a 36 square metre stand at an industrial fair. Cost estimate 48k EUR including travel. Average deal 22k EUR at 40 percent margin, typical lead-to-deal rate 6 percent, sales cycle five months.

title: SME Sales Call Debrief Coach
description_en: Turn call notes or transcripts into a structured debrief with buyer signals, unanswered questions, commitments made, next steps, and coaching points for the rep.
description_de: Wandelt Gesprächsnotizen oder Transkripte in ein strukturiertes Debriefing mit Käufersignalen, offenen Fragen, gemachten Zusagen, nächsten Schritten und Coaching-Hinweisen für den Vertriebsmitarbeiter um.
focus: buyer signals, unanswered questions, commitments, next steps, and coaching points
scenario: Discovery call with a logistics company about a fleet telematics offer. Buyer mentioned budget approval in Q4, a competing pilot, and asked twice about data ownership. Rep promised a reference call and a pricing sheet by Friday.

title: SME Pricing Page Teardown
description_en: Review a pricing page or price list for clarity, anchoring, plan differentiation, hidden friction, and trust gaps, and propose prioritized changes with expected effect.
description_de: Prüft eine Preisseite oder Preisliste auf Klarheit, Ankerwirkung, Plandifferenzierung, verborgene Reibung und Vertrauenslücken und schlägt priorisierte Änderungen mit erwarteter Wirkung vor.
focus: plan clarity, anchoring, differentiation, friction points, trust signals, and prioritized changes
scenario: Online accounting tool offers Basic 9 EUR, Pro 29 EUR, Business 79 EUR per month. Basic gets 70 percent of signups but 40 percent churn in three months. Feature table has 31 rows and no 'most popular' marker.

title: SME Brand Messaging Kit
description_en: Create a compact messaging kit with positioning statement, value pillars, proof points, tone rules, and do-not-say list derived from company facts and customer language.
description_de: Erstellt aus Unternehmensfakten und Kundensprache ein kompaktes Messaging-Kit mit Positionierung, Wertsäulen, Nachweisen, Tonalitätsregeln und einer Liste unerwünschter Formulierungen.
focus: positioning, value pillars, proof points, tone of voice, and messaging guardrails
scenario: Family-owned window manufacturer, 60 years old, 110 employees, sells to builders and private owners. Customers praise 'they just show up and fix it'. Current website leads with 'innovative solutions'.

title: SME Newsletter Content Planner
description_en: Plan a quarter of newsletter issues with topics, audience goals, calls to action, source material needs, and measurement, grounded in existing content and customer questions.
description_de: Plant ein Quartal an Newsletter-Ausgaben mit Themen, Zielgruppenzielen, Handlungsaufforderungen, Materialbedarf und Messung auf Basis vorhandener Inhalte und Kundenfragen.
focus: issue topics, audience goals, calls to action, content sourcing, and measurement
scenario: Garden centre with 6,200 subscribers, 24 percent open rate, sends irregularly. Seasonal peaks in April and November. Existing material: 40 how-to blog posts, event calendar, loyalty program with 900 members.

title: SME Customer Case Study Writer
description_en: Draft a customer case study from project notes and interview fragments with challenge, approach, measurable outcome, quotes marked for approval, and a fact-check list.
description_de: Entwirft aus Projektnotizen und Interviewfragmenten eine Kundenreferenz mit Herausforderung, Vorgehen, messbarem Ergebnis, freigabepflichtigen Zitaten und einer Faktencheck-Liste.
focus: challenge narrative, approach, measurable outcomes, approval-marked quotes, and fact checks
scenario: IT integrator migrated a 45-person law firm to a new document system in eight weeks. Notes mention 'search time cut roughly in half' and 'no downtime during go-live'. The client has not yet approved any quotes.

title: SME Ad Campaign Brief Builder
description_en: Build a paid campaign brief with objective, audience, offer, creative angles, budget split, tracking plan, and kill criteria, with assumptions and evidence gaps made explicit.
description_de: Erstellt ein Briefing für bezahlte Kampagnen mit Ziel, Zielgruppe, Angebot, Kreativansätzen, Budgetaufteilung, Tracking-Plan und Abbruchkriterien mit expliziten Annahmen und Evidenzlücken.
focus: campaign objective, audience, offer, creative angles, budget allocation, tracking, and kill criteria
scenario: Driving school wants 60 new sign-ups in eight weeks for its summer intensive course at 1,890 EUR. Budget 4,500 EUR. Past Instagram ads got sign-ups at about 95 EUR each; Google Ads were never tried.

title: SME Website Copy Refresher
description_en: Rewrite key website sections for clarity and conversion using company facts and customer language, keeping every claim traceable and marking claims that need proof.
description_de: Überarbeitet zentrale Website-Abschnitte für Klarheit und Conversion auf Basis von Unternehmensfakten und Kundensprache, hält jede Aussage nachvollziehbar und markiert belegpflichtige Behauptungen.
focus: headline clarity, benefit language, proof-backed claims, calls to action, and unverified claims
scenario: Electrician company homepage says 'We are the best in the region' with no proof. Facts available: 1,200 jobs last year, 4.8 star rating from 310 reviews, emergency service within 2 hours in the city.

title: SME Event Promotion Planner
description_en: Plan promotion for a workshop, open house, or webinar with channel timeline, messages, registration funnel, reminder cadence, and post-event follow-up.
description_de: Plant die Bewerbung eines Workshops, Tags der offenen Tür oder Webinars mit Kanalzeitplan, Botschaften, Registrierungsfunnel, Erinnerungsrhythmus und Nachbereitung.
focus: channel timeline, message sequence, registration funnel, reminders, and follow-up
scenario: Machine tool dealer hosts an open house in six weeks for 80 guests. Assets: customer list of 1,100 contacts, LinkedIn page with 2,300 followers, three partner suppliers willing to co-promote.

title: SME Social Media Crisis Responder
description_en: Assess a negative social media situation, classify severity, draft holding and follow-up statements, define who approves what, and set monitoring and escalation rules.
description_de: Bewertet eine negative Social-Media-Situation, klassifiziert den Schweregrad, entwirft Erst- und Folgestatements, legt Freigaben fest und definiert Monitoring- und Eskalationsregeln.
focus: severity assessment, holding statement, approval path, monitoring, and escalation rules
scenario: A video of a delivery driver throwing a parcel over a fence has 40k views and names the courier company. Three local news accounts reposted it. The driver is a subcontractor; the facts are not yet confirmed internally.

title: SME Product Description Generator
description_en: Generate consistent, fact-based product descriptions for shop or catalogue use from specification data, with benefit framing, SEO terms, and flags for missing attributes.
description_de: Erzeugt aus Spezifikationsdaten konsistente, faktenbasierte Produktbeschreibungen für Shop oder Katalog mit Nutzenargumentation, SEO-Begriffen und Hinweisen auf fehlende Attribute.
focus: specification accuracy, benefit framing, search terms, consistency, and missing attributes
scenario: Workwear shop imports 120 new items with attributes: material, weight, norms (EN ISO 20471), colours, sizes. Twenty items lack a care instruction field. Tone: practical, no superlatives.

title: SME Marketing Budget Allocator
description_en: Allocate a marketing budget across channels based on past performance, goals, and constraints, with scenario ranges, test reserves, and review triggers.
description_de: Verteilt ein Marketingbudget anhand vergangener Performance, Zielen und Einschränkungen auf Kanäle, mit Szenariobandbreiten, Testreserven und Review-Triggern.
focus: channel performance, goal alignment, allocation scenarios, test reserve, and review triggers
scenario: Kitchen studio has 60k EUR for next year. Last year: Google Ads 22k spend, 41 leads; Facebook 9k, 33 leads; print 12k, 8 leads; showroom events 6k, 19 leads. Goal: 30 percent more qualified appointments.

title: SME Complaint Root Cause Clusterer
description_en: Cluster customer complaints into root-cause groups, estimate frequency and impact, and propose prevention actions with owners and verification checks.
description_de: Gruppiert Kundenbeschwerden nach Ursachen, schätzt Häufigkeit und Auswirkung und schlägt Präventionsmaßnahmen mit Verantwortlichen und Verifikationschecks vor.
focus: complaint clusters, root causes, frequency and impact, prevention actions, and verification
scenario: Online pharmacy received 212 complaints last month: 96 about delivery delays, 48 damaged packaging, 31 wrong item, 37 other. Delivery delays spike on Mondays; the carrier changed in week two.

title: SME Service Level Agreement Drafter
description_en: Draft a practical SLA with service scope, response and resolution targets, exclusions, measurement, and remedies, sized to what the company can realistically deliver.
description_de: Entwirft ein praxistaugliches SLA mit Leistungsumfang, Reaktions- und Lösungszeiten, Ausschlüssen, Messung und Abhilfen, dimensioniert auf das, was das Unternehmen realistisch leisten kann.
focus: service scope, response targets, exclusions, measurement, remedies, and delivery capacity
scenario: Managed IT provider with 6 technicians supports 40 clients. Current promise 'we respond fast'. Ticket data: median first response 3.2 hours, 90th percentile 11 hours. A new client demands a 1-hour response 24/7.

title: SME Support Ticket Triage Rules
description_en: Derive triage categories, priority rules, routing, and canned first responses from historical tickets, and define escalation thresholds and quality checks.
description_de: Leitet aus historischen Tickets Triage-Kategorien, Prioritätsregeln, Routing und Erstantwort-Vorlagen ab und definiert Eskalationsschwellen und Qualitätschecks.
focus: ticket categories, priority rules, routing, first-response templates, and escalation thresholds
scenario: E-bike retailer handles 900 tickets per month via email and phone. Top topics: delivery status, battery questions, warranty claims, return labels. Two agents; the founder still answers warranty cases personally.

title: SME Customer Onboarding Journey Designer
description_en: Design a customer onboarding journey with milestones, communications, success checks, and early-warning signals, based on where customers currently get stuck.
description_de: Entwirft eine Kunden-Onboarding-Journey mit Meilensteinen, Kommunikation, Erfolgsprüfungen und Frühwarnsignalen auf Basis der Stellen, an denen Kunden heute stecken bleiben.
focus: onboarding milestones, communications, success criteria, stuck points, and early-warning signals
scenario: Payroll software for small firms. 38 percent of new accounts never run a first payroll. Support sees the same three questions about importing employees. No onboarding emails exist beyond the welcome mail.

title: SME NPS And Feedback Analyzer
description_en: Analyse survey scores and free-text feedback for themes, drivers of promoters and detractors, and actionable follow-ups, without over-reading small samples.
description_de: Analysiert Umfragewerte und Freitext-Feedback auf Themen, Treiber von Promotoren und Kritikern und umsetzbare Follow-ups, ohne kleine Stichproben zu überinterpretieren.
focus: score drivers, feedback themes, detractor risks, sample limitations, and follow-up actions
scenario: Dental clinic NPS survey: 84 responses, score 41. Detractor comments mention waiting time and unclear cost estimates. Promoters mention staff friendliness. Response rate 12 percent.

title: SME Returns And Refund Policy Optimizer
description_en: Review return data and current policy to balance customer trust, fraud risk, cost, and legal minimums, and propose policy wording, process changes, and metrics.
description_de: Prüft Retourendaten und die aktuelle Richtlinie, um Kundenvertrauen, Missbrauchsrisiko, Kosten und gesetzliche Mindestanforderungen auszubalancieren, und schlägt Formulierungen, Prozessänderungen und Kennzahlen vor.
focus: return drivers, fraud patterns, cost per return, legal minimums, and policy wording
scenario: Fashion webshop: 31 percent return rate, 4 percent of customers cause 28 percent of returns, average return handling cost 6.40 EUR. Current policy: free returns within 60 days. EU 14-day withdrawal right applies.

title: SME Customer Health Scoring
description_en: Define a simple customer health score from usage, support, payment, and relationship signals, classify current accounts, and propose actions per health band.
description_de: Definiert einen einfachen Kundengesundheits-Score aus Nutzungs-, Support-, Zahlungs- und Beziehungssignalen, klassifiziert bestehende Accounts und schlägt Maßnahmen je Gesundheitsstufe vor.
focus: health signals, scoring weights, account classification, and actions per health band
scenario: Cloud backup provider with 260 business accounts. Signals available: last login, storage growth, ticket count, payment delays, contract renewal date. Twelve accounts have had no login for 90 days.

title: SME Service Recovery Playbook
description_en: Create a service recovery playbook for a specific failure with apology framing, remedy options by severity, authority limits for staff, and follow-up verification.
description_de: Erstellt für einen konkreten Servicefehler ein Wiedergutmachungs-Playbook mit Entschuldigungsrahmen, Abhilfeoptionen je Schweregrad, Entscheidungsbefugnissen für Mitarbeitende und Nachverfolgung.
focus: failure severity, remedy options, staff authority limits, apology framing, and follow-up verification
scenario: Hotel with 48 rooms double-booked six rooms on a wedding weekend. Front desk staff currently need the owner's approval for any compensation above 20 EUR. Two guests are already posting online.

title: SME Production Bottleneck Finder
description_en: Locate the constraining step in a production or service flow from cycle times, queues, and downtime notes, and propose capacity, sequencing, and buffer actions with expected effect.
description_de: Findet den begrenzenden Schritt in einem Produktions- oder Serviceablauf anhand von Taktzeiten, Warteschlangen und Ausfallnotizen und schlägt Kapazitäts-, Reihenfolge- und Puffermaßnahmen mit erwarteter Wirkung vor.
focus: constraint identification, cycle times, queues, capacity levers, and sequencing actions
scenario: CNC job shop with five stations. Deburring station has 3 days of queue while milling waits idle 20 percent of the time. Deburring is manual with two staff, one on sick leave. Delivery reliability dropped to 71 percent.

title: SME Preventive Maintenance Scheduler
description_en: Build a preventive maintenance plan from asset lists, failure history, and manufacturer intervals, prioritizing by risk and production impact, with checklists and ownership.
description_de: Erstellt aus Anlagenlisten, Ausfallhistorie und Herstellerintervallen einen vorbeugenden Instandhaltungsplan, priorisiert nach Risiko und Produktionswirkung, mit Checklisten und Verantwortlichkeiten.
focus: asset criticality, failure history, maintenance intervals, checklists, and ownership
scenario: Plastics moulder with 12 injection machines, two compressors, one chiller. Three unplanned stops last quarter, all on the two oldest machines. Manufacturer recommends 2,000-hour service; current practice is 'when it breaks'.

title: SME Quality Defect Pareto Analyzer
description_en: Rank defect types by frequency and cost, link them to likely process causes, and propose containment and corrective actions with measurement and owners.
description_de: Ordnet Fehlerarten nach Häufigkeit und Kosten, verknüpft sie mit wahrscheinlichen Prozessursachen und schlägt Sofort- und Korrekturmaßnahmen mit Messung und Verantwortlichen vor.
focus: defect ranking, cost of quality, process causes, containment, and corrective actions
scenario: Cabinet maker logged 340 defects in six months: 140 surface scratches, 90 wrong dimensions, 60 hinge misalignment, 50 other. Scratches mostly occur after the new packaging line started in March.

title: SME Capacity Planning Assistant
description_en: Compare demand forecasts with available labour and machine capacity, identify shortfalls by week, and propose overtime, subcontracting, hiring, or sequencing options with cost notes.
description_de: Vergleicht Nachfrageprognosen mit verfügbarer Personal- und Maschinenkapazität, erkennt wöchentliche Engpässe und schlägt Überstunden, Fremdvergabe, Einstellungen oder Reihenfolgeoptionen mit Kostenhinweisen vor.
focus: demand versus capacity, weekly shortfalls, overtime and subcontracting options, and cost trade-offs
scenario: Print shop expects a 40 percent order peak in weeks 44 to 50. Two presses run 16 hours per day, staff of 9 with 1.5 open positions. A subcontractor offers capacity at 18 percent higher unit cost.

title: SME Changeover Time Reducer
description_en: Analyse a changeover or setup process, separate internal from external steps, and propose a SMED-style plan with expected time savings, tooling needs, and verification runs.
description_de: Analysiert einen Rüst- oder Umstellprozess, trennt interne von externen Schritten und schlägt einen SMED-Plan mit erwarteter Zeitersparnis, Werkzeugbedarf und Verifikationsläufen vor.
focus: internal versus external steps, setup waste, standardization, expected savings, and verification
scenario: Food packaging line changeover takes 95 minutes, 22 times per week. Steps include fetching tools from the storeroom, waiting for QA approval, and manual guide-rail adjustment without markings.

title: SME Work Instruction Writer
description_en: Convert expert explanations into step-by-step work instructions with safety notes, quality checkpoints, required tools, and common-mistake warnings for new staff.
description_de: Wandelt Expertenerklärungen in Schritt-für-Schritt-Arbeitsanweisungen mit Sicherheitshinweisen, Qualitätsprüfpunkten, benötigten Werkzeugen und Warnungen vor typischen Fehlern für neue Mitarbeitende um.
focus: step sequence, safety notes, quality checkpoints, tools, and common mistakes
scenario: Senior technician explains how to calibrate a filling machine in a 12-minute voice memo. He mentions two 'tricks' nobody wrote down and one step that must never be done with the pump running.

title: SME Corrective Action Tracker
description_en: Turn audit findings, incidents, and customer claims into a corrective and preventive action list with priority, owner, due date, evidence of closure, and effectiveness check.
description_de: Wandelt Auditfeststellungen, Vorfälle und Kundenreklamationen in eine Korrektur- und Vorbeugungsmaßnahmenliste mit Priorität, Verantwortlichem, Frist, Abschlussnachweis und Wirksamkeitsprüfung um.
focus: finding classification, corrective actions, owners and due dates, closure evidence, and effectiveness
scenario: ISO 9001 surveillance audit produced 2 minor nonconformities and 6 observations. Additionally two customer claims about labelling. Next audit in 11 months; the quality manager works part-time.

title: SME Fleet Utilization Optimizer
description_en: Review vehicle or equipment utilization, idle time, and cost per unit to propose right-sizing, sharing, replacement, or scheduling changes with payback estimates.
description_de: Prüft Auslastung, Leerlaufzeiten und Stückkosten von Fahrzeugen oder Geräten und schlägt Anpassungen der Flottengröße, Sharing, Ersatz oder Planungsänderungen mit Amortisationsschätzungen vor.
focus: utilization rates, idle cost, right-sizing, replacement timing, and payback
scenario: Landscaping company runs 14 vans and 6 trailers. Telematics shows 4 vans below 35 percent utilization, two vans over 11 years old with rising repair costs, and peak demand only from April to October.

title: SME Supplier Risk Scorecard
description_en: Score suppliers on delivery performance, quality, financial signals, concentration, and geography, and propose mitigation such as dual sourcing, stock buffers, or contract changes.
description_de: Bewertet Lieferanten nach Lieferperformance, Qualität, Finanzsignalen, Konzentration und Geografie und schlägt Absicherungen wie Zweitquellen, Bestandspuffer oder Vertragsänderungen vor.
focus: delivery and quality performance, financial signals, concentration risk, and mitigation options
scenario: Electronics assembler buys 60 percent of PCB volume from one supplier in Asia with 87 percent on-time delivery. Second supplier is 30 percent more expensive. One critical connector has a single source with 16-week lead time.

title: SME Purchase Price Variance Analyzer
description_en: Analyse purchase price changes across suppliers and materials, separate market effects from negotiation and volume effects, and propose renegotiation or substitution actions.
description_de: Analysiert Einkaufspreisänderungen über Lieferanten und Materialien, trennt Markteffekte von Verhandlungs- und Mengeneffekten und schlägt Nachverhandlungen oder Substitutionen vor.
focus: price variance drivers, market versus negotiation effects, volume impact, and renegotiation targets
scenario: Furniture maker's oak veneer price rose 23 percent in a year while the market index rose 9 percent. Adhesive prices fell 4 percent. Volumes with the veneer supplier dropped after a second supplier was added.

title: SME Reorder Point Calculator
description_en: Derive reorder points and order quantities from demand history, lead times, and service level targets, and flag items where data quality makes the result unreliable.
description_de: Leitet Bestellpunkte und Bestellmengen aus Bedarfshistorie, Lieferzeiten und Servicegradzielen ab und markiert Artikel, bei denen die Datenqualität das Ergebnis unzuverlässig macht.
focus: demand variability, lead times, safety stock, order quantities, and data reliability
scenario: Spare parts dealer with 2,400 SKUs. Top 50 items have 12 months of daily sales data; lead times range from 2 to 45 days. Target service level 97 percent for A items. Stockouts last month: 38.

title: SME Incoming Goods Inspection Plan
description_en: Design a risk-based incoming inspection plan with sampling rules, acceptance criteria, escalation on failure, and supplier feedback loops.
description_de: Entwirft einen risikobasierten Wareneingangsprüfplan mit Stichprobenregeln, Annahmekriterien, Eskalation bei Fehlern und Rückmeldeschleifen zum Lieferanten.
focus: risk-based sampling, acceptance criteria, failure escalation, and supplier feedback
scenario: Medical device assembler receives 80 part numbers from 14 suppliers. Two suppliers caused 70 percent of rejections. Current inspection: visual check of everything by one person, no records of results.

title: SME Logistics Cost Benchmark
description_en: Break down shipping and logistics cost per order, lane, and carrier, compare against alternatives, and propose consolidation, packaging, or contract actions with savings estimates.
description_de: Schlüsselt Versand- und Logistikkosten je Auftrag, Route und Spediteur auf, vergleicht sie mit Alternativen und schlägt Konsolidierung, Verpackungs- oder Vertragsmaßnahmen mit Einsparschätzungen vor.
focus: cost per shipment, lane and carrier comparison, consolidation, packaging, and savings
scenario: Cosmetics brand ships 9,000 parcels per month with two carriers. Average cost 5.90 EUR, 14 percent of parcels use oversized boxes, and 22 percent go to three postcode regions where a third carrier offers 4.80 EUR.

title: SME Make-Or-Buy Decider
description_en: Compare in-house production versus outsourcing for a component or service on cost, capacity, quality, lead time, and strategic control, and recommend a decision with conditions.
description_de: Vergleicht Eigenfertigung und Fremdbezug für eine Komponente oder Leistung nach Kosten, Kapazität, Qualität, Durchlaufzeit und strategischer Kontrolle und empfiehlt eine Entscheidung mit Bedingungen.
focus: full cost comparison, capacity effects, quality and lead time, strategic control, and decision conditions
scenario: Machine builder welds its own frames at 410 EUR per unit with a two-person team near retirement. A contractor quotes 355 EUR with 3-week lead time. Volumes: 600 frames per year, rising.

title: SME Warehouse Slotting Advisor
description_en: Propose warehouse slotting and pick path improvements from pick frequency, item size, and order profiles, with expected pick-time savings and a low-risk implementation sequence.
description_de: Schlägt anhand von Pickhäufigkeit, Artikelgröße und Auftragsprofilen Verbesserungen bei Lagerplatzvergabe und Pickwegen vor, mit erwarteter Zeitersparnis und einer risikoarmen Umsetzungsreihenfolge.
focus: pick frequency, slot assignment, pick path, ergonomics, and implementation sequence
scenario: Tool distributor with a 1,800 square metre warehouse. Top 100 SKUs make up 58 percent of picks but are spread across all aisles. Average pick walk 210 metres per order. Heavy items are on upper shelves.

title: SME Supplier Onboarding Checklist
description_en: Create a supplier onboarding checklist with documents, compliance checks, quality agreement points, system setup, and a probation review, adapted to supplier risk class.
description_de: Erstellt eine Lieferanten-Onboarding-Checkliste mit Dokumenten, Compliance-Prüfungen, Qualitätsvereinbarungspunkten, Systemeinrichtung und einer Probezeit-Bewertung, angepasst an die Risikoklasse des Lieferanten.
focus: required documents, compliance checks, quality agreement, system setup, and probation review
scenario: Food manufacturer onboards a new packaging supplier from Turkey. Needs: food-contact certificates, IFS or equivalent, payment terms, article master data in ERP. Supplier is new to EU business.

title: SME Inventory Accuracy Improver
description_en: Diagnose causes of inventory record inaccuracy from count results and process observations, and propose cycle counting, process, and system fixes with measurable targets.
description_de: Diagnostiziert Ursachen ungenauer Bestandsdaten aus Zählergebnissen und Prozessbeobachtungen und schlägt permanente Inventur, Prozess- und Systemkorrekturen mit messbaren Zielen vor.
focus: count discrepancies, process causes, cycle counting design, system fixes, and accuracy targets
scenario: Building materials dealer found 19 percent of locations with discrepancies at the annual count. Causes suspected: unbooked returns, split pallets, drivers picking without scanning. No cycle counts exist.

title: SME Job Description Writer
description_en: Write a clear, inclusive job description with real responsibilities, must-have versus nice-to-have requirements, and honest working conditions from role notes and team context.
description_de: Verfasst aus Rollennotizen und Teamkontext eine klare, inklusive Stellenbeschreibung mit tatsächlichen Aufgaben, Muss- und Kann-Anforderungen sowie ehrlichen Arbeitsbedingungen.
focus: responsibilities, must-have versus nice-to-have requirements, inclusive language, and realistic conditions
scenario: Heating installer needs a service technician for a team of six. Requirements from the owner: 'gas certificate, driving licence, ideally heat pump experience, must be able to handle customers'. Weekend on-call every fifth week.

title: SME Interview Question Bank
description_en: Generate structured, role-specific interview questions with what good answers look like, scoring anchors, and legally sensitive topics to avoid.
description_de: Erzeugt strukturierte, rollenspezifische Interviewfragen mit Merkmalen guter Antworten, Bewertungsankern und rechtlich sensiblen Themen, die vermieden werden müssen.
focus: competency-based questions, answer quality anchors, scoring, and legally sensitive topics
scenario: Hiring an office manager for a 25-person architecture firm. Key competencies: organisation, vendor handling, discretion, basic bookkeeping. Two partners interview separately and currently ask different questions.

title: SME Employee Retention Risk Radar
description_en: Identify retention risks from workload, pay signals, engagement notes, and manager observations, and propose respectful, reviewable actions per risk cluster.
description_de: Erkennt Bindungsrisiken aus Arbeitslast, Gehaltssignalen, Engagement-Notizen und Beobachtungen von Führungskräften und schlägt respektvolle, prüfbare Maßnahmen je Risikocluster vor.
focus: retention risk signals, workload and pay factors, manager observations, and respectful actions
scenario: Software agency with 32 staff lost four developers in six months. Exit notes mention on-call load and salaries below market. Two senior developers declined the last team event. Salary benchmark data is two years old.

title: SME Performance Review Preparer
description_en: Prepare a balanced performance review from goals, evidence, and feedback notes, with specific examples, development suggestions, and a fair conversation outline.
description_de: Bereitet aus Zielen, Belegen und Feedbacknotizen ein ausgewogenes Mitarbeitergespräch mit konkreten Beispielen, Entwicklungsvorschlägen und einer fairen Gesprächsstruktur vor.
focus: goal achievement evidence, specific examples, development suggestions, and fair conversation structure
scenario: Project manager hit two of three annual goals, received praise from two clients, and missed a budget by 12 percent on one project. Peer feedback mentions late status reports. Salary discussion is expected.

title: SME Shift Roster Builder
description_en: Build a shift roster proposal from demand patterns, staff availability, skills, and legal rest rules, and flag conflicts, overtime risk, and fairness issues.
description_de: Erstellt aus Bedarfsmustern, Verfügbarkeiten, Qualifikationen und gesetzlichen Ruhezeiten einen Schichtplanvorschlag und markiert Konflikte, Überstundenrisiken und Fairnessprobleme.
focus: demand coverage, availability and skills, legal rest rules, overtime risk, and fairness
scenario: Care home needs 24/7 coverage with 3 staff per day shift, 2 at night. 18 employees, 4 part-time, 2 on parental leave from next month. Legal minimum rest 11 hours; two staff have no night shift clearance.

title: SME Team Training Plan Builder
description_en: Create an annual training plan from skill gaps, certification deadlines, and budget, with prioritized courses, internal versus external delivery, and success measures.
description_de: Erstellt aus Kompetenzlücken, Zertifizierungsfristen und Budget einen Jahres-Schulungsplan mit priorisierten Kursen, interner oder externer Durchführung und Erfolgsmessung.
focus: skill gaps, certification deadlines, course prioritization, delivery format, and success measures
scenario: Electrical contractor with 40 technicians. Six certifications expire this year, four staff need PV installation training, budget 28k EUR, and the new ERP goes live in September.

title: SME Exit Interview Analyzer
description_en: Analyse exit interview notes for recurring themes, distinguish individual from systemic causes, and propose retention improvements with owners and follow-up checks.
description_de: Analysiert Austrittsgesprächsnotizen auf wiederkehrende Themen, unterscheidet individuelle von systemischen Ursachen und schlägt Bindungsverbesserungen mit Verantwortlichen und Nachprüfungen vor.
focus: recurring themes, individual versus systemic causes, retention improvements, and follow-up checks
scenario: Restaurant group with five locations had 11 exits in the kitchen teams this year. Notes mention split shifts, one head chef's tone, and lack of schedule predictability. Two exits were relocations.

title: SME Internal Announcement Writer
description_en: Draft an internal announcement for a change such as a new policy, reorganisation, or system rollout, with clear reasons, what changes for whom, timeline, and Q&A.
description_de: Entwirft eine interne Mitteilung zu einer Änderung wie einer neuen Richtlinie, Umstrukturierung oder Systemeinführung mit klaren Gründen, Auswirkungen je Gruppe, Zeitplan und Fragen und Antworten.
focus: change rationale, impact per group, timeline, tone, and anticipated questions
scenario: Logistics company introduces a new time-tracking app for 90 drivers and 20 office staff from 1 November. Works council agreed. Drivers fear surveillance; office staff worry about a second login.

title: SME Apprenticeship Program Planner
description_en: Plan an apprenticeship or trainee program with rotation schedule, learning goals per phase, mentor roles, evaluation points, and recruiting steps sized to the company.
description_de: Plant ein Ausbildungs- oder Traineeprogramm mit Rotationsplan, Lernzielen je Phase, Mentorenrollen, Bewertungspunkten und Recruiting-Schritten, dimensioniert auf das Unternehmen.
focus: rotation schedule, learning goals, mentor roles, evaluation points, and recruiting steps
scenario: Precision mechanics company with 45 staff wants to take its first two apprentices next September. Master craftsman available as trainer 4 hours per week. No previous experience with the chamber of crafts process.

title: SME GDPR Processing Register Builder
description_en: Build a draft record of processing activities from system and process descriptions, with purposes, data categories, legal basis candidates, retention, and items that need legal review.
description_de: Erstellt aus System- und Prozessbeschreibungen ein Verzeichnis von Verarbeitungstätigkeiten im Entwurf mit Zwecken, Datenkategorien, möglichen Rechtsgrundlagen, Aufbewahrung und rechtlich zu prüfenden Punkten.
focus: processing activities, data categories, legal basis candidates, retention, and legal review items
scenario: Online language school uses a CRM, a video platform, a payment provider, and Google Workspace. Stores student recordings for 12 months. No processing register exists; a data protection officer is not appointed.

title: SME Contract Clause Risk Scanner
description_en: Scan a contract draft for risky clauses such as liability, termination, payment terms, IP, and exclusivity, explain the business impact in plain language, and list negotiation points for legal review.
description_de: Prüft einen Vertragsentwurf auf riskante Klauseln wie Haftung, Kündigung, Zahlungsbedingungen, geistiges Eigentum und Exklusivität, erklärt die geschäftliche Wirkung verständlich und listet Verhandlungspunkte für die Rechtsprüfung auf.
focus: liability, termination, payment terms, intellectual property, exclusivity, and negotiation points
scenario: Software studio receives a 30-page framework agreement from a corporate client with unlimited liability, 90-day payment terms, full IP assignment including pre-existing tools, and a 24-month exclusivity clause.

title: SME Workplace Safety Risk Assessment
description_en: Create a structured hazard and risk assessment for a workplace or activity with likelihood, severity, existing controls, additional measures, and documentation needs.
description_de: Erstellt eine strukturierte Gefährdungsbeurteilung für einen Arbeitsplatz oder eine Tätigkeit mit Wahrscheinlichkeit, Schwere, bestehenden Schutzmaßnahmen, zusätzlichen Maßnahmen und Dokumentationsbedarf.
focus: hazard identification, likelihood and severity, existing controls, additional measures, and documentation
scenario: Roofing company with 14 workers. Activities: flat roof work, use of gas burners, ladder access, lifting with a mobile crane. One near-miss with a ladder last month. Last documented assessment is from 2019.

title: SME ESG Supplier Questionnaire Responder
description_en: Prepare answers to a customer's sustainability or supply-chain questionnaire from available company evidence, mark gaps honestly, and plan the evidence to collect next.
description_de: Bereitet Antworten auf den Nachhaltigkeits- oder Lieferkettenfragebogen eines Kunden aus vorhandenen Unternehmensnachweisen vor, markiert Lücken ehrlich und plant die als Nächstes zu sammelnden Nachweise.
focus: questionnaire mapping, available evidence, honest gaps, and evidence collection plan
scenario: Metal parts supplier receives a 60-question ESG questionnaire from an automotive customer. Available: energy bills, waste contracts, code of conduct draft, no CO2 balance, no supplier code signed by sub-suppliers.

title: SME Carbon Footprint Estimator
description_en: Estimate a first scope 1 and 2 carbon footprint from energy, fuel, and fleet data with transparent factors and assumptions, and list scope 3 hotspots to investigate.
description_de: Schätzt aus Energie-, Kraftstoff- und Flottendaten einen ersten Scope-1- und Scope-2-CO2-Fußabdruck mit transparenten Faktoren und Annahmen und listet zu untersuchende Scope-3-Hotspots auf.
focus: scope 1 and 2 estimation, emission factor assumptions, data gaps, and scope 3 hotspots
scenario: Laundry service uses 420 MWh gas, 180 MWh electricity, 12 delivery vans with 48,000 litres of diesel per year. Electricity contract claims green tariff without certificate. Purchased detergents are the largest material input.

title: SME Whistleblower Case Handler
description_en: Structure the handling of an internal report with confidentiality steps, acknowledgement timelines, investigation plan, conflict-of-interest checks, and documentation, marking legal review points.
description_de: Strukturiert die Bearbeitung einer internen Meldung mit Vertraulichkeitsschritten, Bestätigungsfristen, Untersuchungsplan, Prüfung von Interessenkonflikten und Dokumentation und markiert rechtliche Prüfpunkte.
focus: confidentiality, acknowledgement deadlines, investigation plan, conflict of interest, and documentation
scenario: Anonymous report via the new hint line alleges that a warehouse supervisor pressures staff to skip safety checks. The supervisor is the brother-in-law of the operations manager. Company has 62 employees.

title: SME Business Continuity Planner
description_en: Build a business continuity plan for critical processes with impact analysis, recovery priorities, workarounds, contacts, and test schedule, sized for a small organisation.
description_de: Erstellt einen Notfall- und Kontinuitätsplan für kritische Prozesse mit Auswirkungsanalyse, Wiederanlaufprioritäten, Umgehungslösungen, Kontakten und Testplan, dimensioniert für eine kleine Organisation.
focus: critical processes, impact analysis, recovery priorities, workarounds, and test schedule
scenario: Accounting firm with 18 staff depends on one server, a single internet line, and two partners who hold all client passwords. A water leak took the office offline for two days last winter.

title: SME Insurance Coverage Checker
description_en: Compare business activities and assets with existing insurance policies to spot coverage gaps, overlaps, and outdated sums, and prepare questions for a broker.
description_de: Gleicht Geschäftstätigkeiten und Vermögenswerte mit bestehenden Versicherungspolicen ab, um Deckungslücken, Überschneidungen und veraltete Summen zu erkennen, und bereitet Fragen für den Makler vor.
focus: activity and asset inventory, coverage gaps, overlaps, outdated sums, and broker questions
scenario: Carpentry business added a CNC machine worth 180k EUR and started selling online. Policies: liability from 2016, contents insured at 250k EUR, no cyber cover, no product liability for online sales.

title: SME Regulatory Change Impact Assessor
description_en: Assess what a new regulation or standard means for the company, which processes and documents are affected, what the deadlines are, and which steps need expert confirmation.
description_de: Bewertet, was eine neue Vorschrift oder Norm für das Unternehmen bedeutet, welche Prozesse und Dokumente betroffen sind, welche Fristen gelten und welche Schritte eine Expertenbestätigung benötigen.
focus: applicability, affected processes and documents, deadlines, actions, and expert confirmation
scenario: A 90-employee electronics distributor must assess an upcoming EU product safety regulation. It imports from three non-EU manufacturers, has no designated responsible person, and its product documentation is in supplier PDFs.

title: SME Software Selection Matrix
description_en: Turn requirements and vendor information into a weighted selection matrix with must-have gates, total cost of ownership, migration risk, and a recommended shortlist.
description_de: Wandelt Anforderungen und Anbieterinformationen in eine gewichtete Auswahlmatrix mit K.-o.-Kriterien, Gesamtbetriebskosten, Migrationsrisiko und einer empfohlenen Shortlist um.
focus: requirement weighting, must-have gates, total cost of ownership, migration risk, and shortlist
scenario: Wholesaler picks a new ERP from three offers between 60k and 140k EUR. Must-haves: multi-warehouse, EDI with two key customers, German e-invoicing. Current system data export is undocumented.

title: SME IT Asset Lifecycle Planner
description_en: Plan hardware and licence replacements from an asset inventory with age, support status, and cost, producing a budgeted refresh schedule and risk flags for unsupported systems.
description_de: Plant Hardware- und Lizenzersatz aus einem Bestandsverzeichnis mit Alter, Supportstatus und Kosten und erstellt einen budgetierten Erneuerungsplan mit Risikohinweisen für nicht mehr unterstützte Systeme.
focus: asset age and support status, replacement priority, budget schedule, and unsupported system risk
scenario: Tax advisory firm has 34 laptops (11 older than five years), one file server out of vendor support, and 40 office licences on a plan ending next year. Annual IT budget 45k EUR.

title: SME Process Automation Opportunity Finder
description_en: Identify repetitive manual tasks suitable for automation from process descriptions, estimate time savings and effort, and rank candidates with risks and prerequisites.
description_de: Erkennt aus Prozessbeschreibungen wiederkehrende manuelle Aufgaben, die sich für Automatisierung eignen, schätzt Zeitersparnis und Aufwand und priorisiert Kandidaten mit Risiken und Voraussetzungen.
focus: repetitive tasks, time savings estimate, implementation effort, risks, and prerequisites
scenario: Insurance broker's back office spends 25 hours per week copying policy data from PDFs into the CRM, 8 hours creating renewal reminders manually, and 6 hours reconciling commission statements in spreadsheets.

title: SME Backup And Recovery Check
description_en: Assess backup coverage, frequency, retention, offsite copies, and restore testing against the company's tolerance for data loss and downtime, and propose a prioritized fix list.
description_de: Bewertet Backup-Abdeckung, Häufigkeit, Aufbewahrung, externe Kopien und Wiederherstellungstests gegenüber der Toleranz des Unternehmens für Datenverlust und Ausfallzeit und schlägt eine priorisierte Fix-Liste vor.
focus: backup coverage, recovery objectives, offsite copies, restore testing, and prioritized fixes
scenario: Architecture office stores project files on a NAS with nightly backup to a USB drive kept in the same room. Cloud email is not backed up. Last restore test: never. Acceptable data loss per owner: one day.

title: SME AI Use Policy Drafter
description_en: Draft a practical internal AI usage policy with allowed and prohibited uses, data handling rules, review duties, tool approval, and training needs, marking points for legal review.
description_de: Entwirft eine praxisnahe interne Richtlinie zur KI-Nutzung mit erlaubten und verbotenen Anwendungen, Datenregeln, Prüfpflichten, Tool-Freigabe und Schulungsbedarf und markiert rechtliche Prüfpunkte.
focus: allowed and prohibited uses, data handling, human review duties, tool approval, and training
textarea_label: Company context and tools in use
scenario: Consulting boutique with 22 staff. Several consultants already paste client documents into public chat tools. Clients include two banks with strict confidentiality clauses. No policy exists.

title: SME Website Analytics Interpreter
description_en: Interpret website analytics exports for traffic, conversion, and content signals, separate real trends from noise, and propose next experiments with success criteria.
description_de: Interpretiert Website-Analytics-Exporte nach Traffic-, Conversion- und Content-Signalen, trennt echte Trends von Rauschen und schlägt nächste Experimente mit Erfolgskriterien vor.
focus: traffic and conversion signals, trend versus noise, content performance, and next experiments
scenario: Dental lab website: 4,200 monthly sessions, 38 contact form submissions, bounce rate rose from 48 to 61 percent since a redesign in May. Mobile share is 67 percent; the form has nine fields.

title: SME Access And Password Review
description_en: Review user accounts, shared credentials, admin rights, and leaver handling against least-privilege principles, and produce a prioritized cleanup and control plan.
description_de: Prüft Benutzerkonten, geteilte Zugangsdaten, Administratorrechte und Austrittsprozesse nach dem Prinzip der minimalen Rechte und erstellt einen priorisierten Bereinigungs- und Kontrollplan.
focus: account inventory, shared credentials, admin rights, leaver handling, and control plan
scenario: Marketing agency with 28 staff shares one login for three social media accounts, has 9 users with admin rights on the file server, and two former employees still appear in the CRM user list.

title: SME Customer Data Deduplication Planner
description_en: Plan the deduplication and merge of customer records across systems with matching rules, survivorship logic, exception handling, and a validation sample before bulk changes.
description_de: Plant die Bereinigung und Zusammenführung von Kundendatensätzen über Systeme hinweg mit Abgleichregeln, Survivorship-Logik, Ausnahmebehandlung und einer Validierungsstichprobe vor Massenänderungen.
focus: matching rules, survivorship logic, exception handling, validation sampling, and rollback
scenario: Wholesaler has 14,000 customer records in ERP and 9,500 in the CRM with an estimated 20 percent overlap. Names differ in spelling, VAT IDs are only in ERP, and sales reps fear losing notes.

title: SME Digital Maturity Assessment
description_en: Assess digital maturity across processes, data, tools, skills, and security from a self-description, and produce a realistic 12-month roadmap with quick wins and prerequisites.
description_de: Bewertet die digitale Reife in Prozessen, Daten, Tools, Kompetenzen und Sicherheit anhand einer Selbstbeschreibung und erstellt eine realistische 12-Monats-Roadmap mit Quick Wins und Voraussetzungen.
focus: maturity per dimension, quick wins, prerequisites, 12-month roadmap, and capacity constraints
scenario: Regional bakery with 9 shops runs orders by phone and paper, uses a cash register system without reporting, has no shared calendar, and wants online pre-ordering. The owner's son handles IT part-time.

title: SME OKR Drafting Assistant
description_en: Translate strategic intent into quarterly objectives and measurable key results with owners, baselines, and risks, and flag results that are activities rather than outcomes.
description_de: Übersetzt strategische Absichten in Quartalsziele und messbare Key Results mit Verantwortlichen, Ausgangswerten und Risiken und markiert Ergebnisse, die Aktivitäten statt Wirkungen beschreiben.
focus: objective clarity, measurable key results, baselines, owners, and activity-versus-outcome checks
scenario: Software company goal: 'become the go-to tool for craft businesses in Bavaria'. Current: 320 customers, 4 percent monthly churn, NPS unknown, 2 sales staff. Leadership wants three objectives for Q1.

title: SME Competitor Intelligence Brief
description_en: Consolidate public competitor observations into a brief with positioning, pricing signals, strengths, weaknesses, and implications, clearly separating verified facts from inference.
description_de: Verdichtet öffentliche Wettbewerbsbeobachtungen zu einem Briefing mit Positionierung, Preissignalen, Stärken, Schwächen und Implikationen und trennt verifizierte Fakten klar von Schlussfolgerungen.
focus: competitor positioning, pricing signals, strengths and weaknesses, implications, and fact-versus-inference
scenario: Two new competitors opened in a regional HVAC market: one national chain with 24/7 hotline, one startup with online booking and fixed prices. Own company has 9 technicians and no online booking.

title: SME Evidence-Based SWOT Builder
description_en: Build a SWOT where every entry is backed by a stated fact or marked as assumption, then derive three to five strategic options with trade-offs and next validation steps.
description_de: Erstellt eine SWOT, in der jeder Eintrag durch einen genannten Fakt belegt oder als Annahme markiert ist, und leitet daraus drei bis fünf strategische Optionen mit Trade-offs und nächsten Validierungsschritten ab.
focus: evidence-backed strengths and weaknesses, opportunities, threats, strategic options, and validation
scenario: Family-run brewery, 28 employees, 70 percent of sales through regional gastronomy. Facts: three awards, ageing bottling line, growing non-alcoholic demand, two pubs closed last year, export enquiry from Denmark.

title: SME Annual Planning Workshop Preparer
description_en: Prepare an annual planning workshop with agenda, pre-read facts, decision questions, scenario prompts, and a decision log template, based on the year's results and open issues.
description_de: Bereitet einen Jahresplanungs-Workshop mit Agenda, Vorab-Fakten, Entscheidungsfragen, Szenarioimpulsen und einer Entscheidungsprotokoll-Vorlage auf Basis der Jahresergebnisse und offenen Themen vor.
focus: agenda design, fact pre-read, decision questions, scenarios, and decision log
scenario: Engineering office with three partners and 22 staff. Revenue plus 6 percent, margin down 3 points, two large projects ending in Q2, partners disagree on hiring versus subcontracting. Workshop is one day.

title: SME Pricing Experiment Designer
description_en: Design a controlled pricing or packaging experiment with hypothesis, segments, sample size logic, guardrails, and decision rules, honest about what small samples can prove.
description_de: Entwirft ein kontrolliertes Preis- oder Paketierungsexperiment mit Hypothese, Segmenten, Stichprobenlogik, Leitplanken und Entscheidungsregeln und ist ehrlich darüber, was kleine Stichproben beweisen können.
focus: hypothesis, segment selection, sample size logic, guardrails, and decision rules
scenario: Meal-kit startup wants to test 59 EUR versus 64 EUR weekly boxes. 1,900 weekly orders, 12 percent weekly churn, CFO fears revenue loss. Website can split traffic by postcode.

title: SME KPI Dashboard Specifier
description_en: Specify a management dashboard with the few KPIs that matter, definitions, data sources, update frequency, owners, and alert thresholds, avoiding vanity metrics.
description_de: Spezifiziert ein Management-Dashboard mit den wenigen entscheidenden KPIs, Definitionen, Datenquellen, Aktualisierungsfrequenz, Verantwortlichen und Alarmschwellen und vermeidet Vanity-Metriken.
focus: KPI selection, definitions, data sources, update cadence, and alert thresholds
scenario: Cleaning services company wants one weekly dashboard for the owner. Data: scheduling tool, invoicing software, timesheets, customer complaints log. Currently 40 metrics are reported monthly and nobody reads them.

title: SME Customer Segmentation Analyzer
description_en: Segment customers from revenue, margin, frequency, and service cost data into actionable groups with profiles, treatment strategies, and data gaps to close.
description_de: Segmentiert Kunden anhand von Umsatz, Marge, Frequenz und Servicekosten in handlungsfähige Gruppen mit Profilen, Betreuungsstrategien und zu schließenden Datenlücken.
focus: segment definition, profitability profiles, treatment strategies, and data gaps
scenario: Industrial supplier with 1,100 active customers. Top 40 make 55 percent of revenue; 500 customers order less than twice a year; service calls are not linked to customer margin. Sales visits are spread evenly.

title: SME Scenario Stress Tester
description_en: Stress-test the business against defined scenarios such as losing a key customer, cost shocks, or staff loss, quantify impact with stated assumptions, and define trigger-based responses.
description_de: Testet das Geschäft gegen definierte Szenarien wie den Verlust eines Schlüsselkunden, Kostenschocks oder Personalausfall, quantifiziert die Wirkung mit genannten Annahmen und definiert triggerbasierte Reaktionen.
focus: scenario definition, quantified impact, assumptions, early triggers, and response plans
scenario: Contract manufacturer with 55 staff: largest customer 34 percent of revenue, steel is 40 percent of material cost, two of three CNC programmers are over 60. Cash reserve covers seven weeks.

title: SME Partnership Fit Evaluator
description_en: Evaluate a proposed partnership, joint venture, or reseller deal for strategic fit, dependency risk, economics, governance, and exit terms, with questions to resolve before signing.
description_de: Bewertet eine vorgeschlagene Partnerschaft, ein Joint Venture oder einen Reseller-Deal nach strategischem Fit, Abhängigkeitsrisiko, Wirtschaftlichkeit, Governance und Ausstiegsbedingungen mit vor Unterzeichnung zu klärenden Fragen.
focus: strategic fit, dependency risk, economics, governance, exit terms, and open questions
scenario: Sensor startup is offered an exclusive distribution deal for the DACH region by a large wholesaler: 35 percent margin to the partner, minimum volumes unstated, three-year term, and partner branding on the product.

title: SME Grant Application Drafter
description_en: Draft the narrative sections of a grant application from project facts and program criteria, map each claim to evidence, and list missing attachments and consortium confirmations.
description_de: Entwirft die Textteile eines Förderantrags aus Projektfakten und Programmkriterien, ordnet jede Aussage einem Nachweis zu und listet fehlende Anlagen und Konsortialbestätigungen auf.
focus: criteria mapping, narrative drafting, evidence per claim, missing attachments, and confirmations
scenario: Machine builder applies for a regional digitalisation grant of 120k EUR for a predictive maintenance pilot with a university partner. Program criteria: innovation level, SME benefit, job effects, co-funding of 50 percent.

title: SME Public Tender Compliance Matrix
description_en: Extract every mandatory requirement from tender documents into a compliance matrix with status, responsible person, evidence, and deadline, and flag exclusion risks.
description_de: Extrahiert jede Pflichtanforderung aus Ausschreibungsunterlagen in eine Compliance-Matrix mit Status, Verantwortlichem, Nachweis und Frist und markiert Ausschlussrisiken.
focus: mandatory requirements, evidence status, responsible persons, deadlines, and exclusion risks
scenario: Municipal tender for facility cleaning of six schools. Requirements include minimum wage declaration, three references over 200k EUR, ISO 14001 or equivalent, and a bid bond. Submission in 12 days.

title: SME Funding Progress Report Writer
description_en: Write an interim or final report for a funded project from work logs, milestones, and spend data, aligned to the funder's template, with deviations explained and evidence attached.
description_de: Verfasst aus Arbeitsprotokollen, Meilensteinen und Ausgabendaten einen Zwischen- oder Abschlussbericht für ein gefördertes Projekt entlang der Vorlage des Fördergebers, mit erklärten Abweichungen und beigefügten Nachweisen.
focus: milestone status, spend versus plan, deviations, evidence, and funder template alignment
scenario: Funded 18-month R&D project is at month 9. Two of four work packages are complete, personnel spend is at 61 percent of budget, the external lab partner delivered three months late, and a milestone was redefined.

title: SME Subcontractor Bid Consolidator
description_en: Consolidate subcontractor quotes into a bid calculation with scope coverage checks, price normalisation, risk allowances, and open clarifications before submission.
description_de: Fasst Nachunternehmerangebote zu einer Angebotskalkulation zusammen, mit Prüfung der Leistungsabdeckung, Preisnormalisierung, Risikozuschlägen und offenen Klärungspunkten vor Abgabe.
focus: scope coverage, price normalisation, risk allowances, open clarifications, and bid summary
scenario: General contractor prepares a 1.4M EUR school renovation bid with quotes from five trades. The electrical quote excludes fire alarm wiring, two quotes have different validity dates, and the roofing quote is per square metre without quantities.

title: SME Innovation Voucher Fit Checker
description_en: Check a planned innovation or consulting project against typical small-grant and voucher program criteria, estimate eligible costs, and list the documents and partners needed.
description_de: Prüft ein geplantes Innovations- oder Beratungsprojekt gegen typische Kriterien kleiner Förder- und Gutscheinprogramme, schätzt förderfähige Kosten und listet benötigte Dokumente und Partner auf.
focus: eligibility criteria, eligible costs, required partners, documents, and application timing
scenario: Textile printing company wants to develop a water-saving pretreatment process with a technical university. Budget 45k EUR, 18 employees, founded 2009, never received public funding.

title: SME Tender Debrief Learning Log
description_en: Turn tender award notices and debrief feedback into a learning log with scoring gaps, pricing position, missing evidence, and concrete changes for the next bid.
description_de: Wandelt Zuschlagsmitteilungen und Debriefing-Feedback in ein Lernprotokoll mit Bewertungslücken, Preisposition, fehlenden Nachweisen und konkreten Änderungen für das nächste Angebot um.
focus: scoring gaps, price position, missing evidence, and changes for the next bid
scenario: IT firm lost a public software maintenance tender: scored 68 of 100 on quality versus the winner's 84, price 7 percent lower than the winner. Feedback cites weak transition concept and missing security certifications.

title: SME Customer Training Curriculum Builder
description_en: Design a customer or partner training curriculum from product knowledge and support questions with modules, learning objectives, formats, assessments, and maintenance plan.
description_de: Entwirft aus Produktwissen und Supportfragen ein Kunden- oder Partnerschulungscurriculum mit Modulen, Lernzielen, Formaten, Prüfungen und Pflegeplan.
focus: module structure, learning objectives, formats, assessments, and content maintenance
scenario: Software vendor for craft businesses wants a partner certification. Support data shows 60 percent of tickets concern invoicing setup and mobile app sync. Partners have 2 hours per week for training.

title: SME Knowledge Base Article Writer
description_en: Convert support answers and expert notes into clear knowledge base articles with problem statement, steps, screenshots to add, related articles, and review owner.
description_de: Wandelt Supportantworten und Expertennotizen in klare Wissensdatenbank-Artikel mit Problembeschreibung, Schritten, zu ergänzenden Screenshots, verwandten Artikeln und Prüfverantwortlichem um.
focus: problem statement, step clarity, missing visuals, related articles, and review ownership
scenario: Ticketing shows 140 emails in three months answering how to connect a card reader to the POS app. Two agents wrote different answers; the correct procedure changed with the last app update.

title: SME Micro-Learning Series Planner
description_en: Plan a series of short learning units for staff on a specific topic with objectives, sequencing, formats, practice tasks, and knowledge checks that fit into daily work.
description_de: Plant eine Serie kurzer Lerneinheiten für Mitarbeitende zu einem Thema mit Zielen, Reihenfolge, Formaten, Übungsaufgaben und Wissenschecks, die in den Arbeitsalltag passen.
focus: learning objectives, unit sequencing, formats, practice tasks, and knowledge checks
scenario: Logistics company wants all 70 warehouse staff to learn the new hazardous goods handling rules. Staff have 10 minutes per shift, mixed language levels, and access to a shared tablet per team.

title: SME Mentoring Program Designer
description_en: Design an internal mentoring program with matching criteria, meeting cadence, goals, confidentiality rules, and evaluation, sized to a small team's capacity.
description_de: Entwirft ein internes Mentoring-Programm mit Matching-Kriterien, Treffrhythmus, Zielen, Vertraulichkeitsregeln und Evaluation, dimensioniert auf die Kapazität eines kleinen Teams.
focus: matching criteria, cadence, goals, confidentiality, and evaluation
scenario: Engineering firm with 48 staff has five senior engineers near retirement and eight juniors hired in two years. Leadership wants knowledge transfer without formal training budget.

title: SME Project Lessons Learned Facilitator
description_en: Prepare and structure a project retrospective with timeline reconstruction, what worked, what failed, root causes, and reusable practices, converting them into checklist updates.
description_de: Bereitet eine Projekt-Retrospektive mit Zeitstrahl-Rekonstruktion, Erfolgen, Fehlschlägen, Ursachen und wiederverwendbaren Praktiken vor und überführt diese in Checklisten-Updates.
focus: timeline reconstruction, successes and failures, root causes, reusable practices, and checklist updates
scenario: Trade fair stand construction project ran 30 percent over budget and finished at 3 a.m. before opening. Causes noted: late client changes, a subcontractor no-show, and unclear on-site lead. Next similar project starts in six weeks.

title: SME Expert Knowledge Capture Interviewer
description_en: Generate a structured interview guide and knowledge map to capture a departing expert's tacit knowledge, prioritizing critical, rarely used, and undocumented know-how.
description_de: Erzeugt einen strukturierten Interviewleitfaden und eine Wissenslandkarte, um das implizite Wissen einer ausscheidenden Fachkraft zu sichern, priorisiert nach kritischem, selten genutztem und undokumentiertem Know-how.
focus: critical know-how, rare situations, undocumented procedures, interview questions, and knowledge map
scenario: Head of maintenance retires in five months after 31 years. He alone knows the quirks of three legacy machines, supplier contacts, and how to restart the boiler after a power failure. Nothing is written down.
